subject: Student support rota
body:
2026-10-02T13:45:00+02:00 — Viktor Klein: Nora, I can cover coursework questions during the remaining gap. David's twenty minutes shouldn't turn into a full support shift by accident.
2026-10-02T13:45:58+02:00 — Nora Stein: Thank you. Lena wants technical questions clearly separated. She was booked to discuss an essay, which didn't help either person.
2026-10-02T13:47:05+02:00 — Viktor Klein: Can the form ask which exercise the question concerns? Otherwise I spend the slot locating the instructions rather than helping.
2026-10-02T13:48:23+02:00 — Nora Stein: I'll add guidance for a short heading. Lian also wanted details kept private instead of writing the whole problem to the group.
2026-10-02T13:49:46+02:00 — Viktor Klein: Good. For payment problems, point them to Finance early. I don't want to collect receipts I have no reason to see.
2026-10-02T13:50:50+02:00 — Nora Stein: Theo is sending a routing sentence. I'll put that beside the categories and leave a named handover for any uncovered slot.
